THIS MFA IS FILED U/S 173(1) OF MV ACT AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 14.01.2016 PASSED IN MVC NO.1129/2013 ON THE FILE OF THE 5TH ADDITIONAL DISTRICT & SESSIONS JUDGE, D.K., MANGALURU, SITTING AT PUTTUR, D.K., AWARDING COMPENSATION OF RS.11,97,000/-
WITH INTEREST AT 7% P.A. FROM THE DATE OF PETITION TILL THE DATE OF DEPOSIT.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT
The records discloses that respondent No.1 has died prior to 2018 itself.
However, respondent No.1 himself was claimant before the Tribunal.
However, in spite of granting sufficient opportunities, the legal heirs of deceased respondent No.1/claimant are not brought on record though more than five years have lapsed.
2. In view of the same, the appeal as against respondent No.1/claimant stands abated.
3. In view of abatement of the appeal against claimant, question of continuing the appeal as against respondent No.2-owner does not arise at all.

Sd/-
